whoItsFor: Teams and self-hosters who want a CRM that an AI agent can run and keep up to date, rather than a database with a chat box added. It suits people comfortable deploying a Bun/Postgres monorepo.
useCases: Have an agent research contacts and companies and record only evidence-backed facts
Self-host a single-tenant CRM with Google or Microsoft sign-in and mailbox sync
Review what the agent did and answer its questions from each contact's Agent tab
